mutations.en: The water at the harbour wall went black overnight.
mutations.fr: L'eau au pied de la digue est devenue noire pendant la nuit.

mutations.en: They say the harbour water is black, and something is moving in it.
mutations.fr: On dit que l'eau du port est noire, et que quelque chose y bouge.

mutations.en: The harbour has swallowed its own light, and the fishers will not look down.
mutations.fr: Le port a avale sa propre lumiere, et les pecheurs refusent de baisser les yeux.
